entries.title: 2009 February Operation Clambake 16 protest against Scientology OSA 01.jpg
entries.description: Parti Gras '09 on February 21st in Clearwater, Florida. Enturbulation of Cult security tard successful. Their cute little outfits consisting of a white shirt with khaki pants and tons of unnecessary belt accessories make them easy to spot. As part of the 13th straight month of protests in over 50 cities around the world, Anonymous marched in what the scientology CULT calls it's "Mecca". . With a free concert downtown, many locals were drawn to the area and public support was overwhelming. Many LULZ were had and many Parti Gras beads with small fliers attached were given Last week the mother of Kyle Brennan filed a wrongful death lawsuit against the cult and three of it's members, one being the sister of the cult leader, David Miscavige. Kyle wasn't a scientologist, but unfortunately for him his father was and Kyle died in Clearwater. Front page newspaper article: www.tampabay.com/news/article976561.ece Horrific PDF of court filing: www.tampabay.com/specials/2009/PDFs/Scientology.pdf All faces of those unmasked are blurred to protect them from the cult's "Fair Game" policy of harassing it's critics. These are brave people of all ages and walks of life, standing shoulder to shoulder with ex-Scientologists to bring the truth TO YOU . But don't take my word for it, educate yourself about what TIME Magazine called "The Cult of Greed and Power": www.whyweprotest.net www.xenu.net www.exscientologykids.com

entries.title: 2009 March Clearwater FL protest against Scientology 01.jpg
entries.description: This female scientologist stalker named Barbara tried to hide the Anon's protest sign from view by walking between it and the scilons on the right. When I got in front of her to capture these images, she laughably informed me I had to stay behind her. I simply replied I don't take orders from scientologists. Notice the scientology cult's "double cross" symbol around her neck. Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger on March 13th and 14th 2009 in Clearwater, Florida. This was a big weekend for the cult in Clearwater. The 13th was the cult's annual L.Ron Hubbard Birthday Party at Ruth Eckerd Hall and the 14th was the re-opening of the remodeled Ft. Harrison cult building. Scientology cultists flew in from around the country to attend these cult events, and Anonymous was there. This was the 14th straight month of global protest in over 50 cities around the world. Last week California ABC affiliate KESQ and it's investigative reporter Nathan Baca, started a 12 part report on the scientology cult and it's "Gold Base' in Hemet, CA in particular. This is ground breaking investigative reporting at it's best. The first five parts are linked below. Look for the video link in the upper left of each page. And simply use the built in search engine in the upper right of each page to view the upcoming seven parts, which will air over the next week and a half. entries.description: Photographs of the exterior of the Maumee Branch of the Toledo Lucas County Public Library taken on December 6, 2018. The architectural firm of David L. Stine & Son of Toledo, Ohio designed the building in 1916 and it was constructed in 1918.
